items.title: Charles Schwab (SCHW) Says It Will Not Charge RIA Custody Fees
items.summary: Charles Schwab (NYSE:SCHW) reaffirmed that it will not charge custody fees to registered investment advisers, diverging from peers that have introduced such fees. The brokerage is actively blocking external AI agents from accessing customer accounts, citing security and privacy concerns as consumer interest in AI tools grows. Schwab's dual stance on RIA custody pricing and AI agent access is at the center of today's developments; however, it is not the full story. Check out 1 warning sign...

items.title: RIA Leaders 2026: The custody fee conundrum
items.summary: The lack of a uniform, publicly available listing of revenue collected by custodians has led to calls for a custody fee that would overhaul the industry's traditional business model and clarify how those relationships affect RIAs' fiduciary duty to their clients.
